question_en: Movies and TV series starring Nicole Kidman
question_fr: Films et séries télévisées avec Nicole Kidman
translation_note: Each evaluation carries an English (`question_en`) and a French (`question_fr`) form. One side is the original input typed by the user; the other is automatically translated by gpt-4o (gpt-6-sol since 2026-10-01) through Phase 5 (EN→FR) or Phase 6 (FR→EN) of the evaluator. Translations are generally high-quality but may differ in wording from a natively-typed equivalent — keep this in mind when comparing API outputs across languages.
assertion_refresh_sql:
SELECT U.ID_CONTENT, U.CONTENT_TYPE
  FROM (
        SELECT T_WC_T2S_MOVIE.ID_MOVIE AS ID_CONTENT, 'movie' AS CONTENT_TYPE,
               T_WC_T2S_MOVIE.IMDB_RATING_WEIGHTED AS SORT_KEY
          FROM T_WC_T2S_MOVIE
          JOIN T_WC_T2S_PERSON_MOVIE ON T_WC_T2S_PERSON_MOVIE.ID_MOVIE = T_WC_T2S_MOVIE.ID_MOVIE
          JOIN T_WC_T2S_PERSON ON T_WC_T2S_PERSON.ID_PERSON = T_WC_T2S_PERSON_MOVIE.ID_PERSON
         WHERE T_WC_T2S_PERSON.PERSON_NAME = 'Nicole Kidman'
           AND T_WC_T2S_PERSON_MOVIE.CREDIT_TYPE = 'cast'
           AND (T_WC_T2S_MOVIE.IS_DOCUMENTARY = 1
                OR COALESCE(T_WC_T2S_PERSON_MOVIE.CAST_CHARACTER, '') NOT IN ('Self', 'Himself', 'Herself', '(archive footage)', 'Self (archive footage)', 'Self (archive footage) (uncredited)', 'Self (uncredited)'))
        UNION
        SELECT T_WC_T2S_SERIE.ID_SERIE AS ID_CONTENT, 'serie' AS CONTENT_TYPE,
               T_WC_T2S_SERIE.IMDB_RATING_WEIGHTED AS SORT_KEY
          FROM T_WC_T2S_SERIE
          JOIN T_WC_T2S_PERSON_SERIE ON T_WC_T2S_PERSON_SERIE.ID_SERIE = T_WC_T2S_SERIE.ID_SERIE
          JOIN T_WC_T2S_PERSON ON T_WC_T2S_PERSON.ID_PERSON = T_WC_T2S_PERSON_SERIE.ID_PERSON
         WHERE T_WC_T2S_PERSON.PERSON_NAME = 'Nicole Kidman'
           AND T_WC_T2S_PERSON_SERIE.CREDIT_TYPE = 'cast'
           AND COALESCE(T_WC_T2S_PERSON_SERIE.CAST_CHARACTER, '') NOT IN ('Self', 'Himself', 'Herself', '(archive footage)', 'Self (archive footage)', 'Self (archive footage) (uncredited)', 'Self (uncredited)')
       ) AS U
 ORDER BY U.SORT_KEY DESC, U.CONTENT_TYPE, U.ID_CONTENT
 LIMIT 50
